top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Rise Before Fed Decision, Oil Slips: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian shares rose and bonds posted modest gains as investors awaited the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision, with markets expecting its first hike since 2023. Oil’s rally paused.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: China's AI leaders keep quiet despite U.S. 'publicity' on tech risks
top_signals.summary: Z.ai, Moonshot, MiniMax, Alibaba and Tencent did not provide any statements when contacted by CNBC about the warnings on AI from Silicon Valley.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Crypto longs worth $570 million wiped out as Clarity Act fails
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
